name: Jonathan's Shinjuku Nishiguchi Ogado
nameJa: ジョナサン 新宿西口大ガード店
address: 7-1-1 Nishi-Shinjuku, Shinjuku Kaleido Building 3F, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
description: A branch of the Jonathan's famiresu (family restaurant) near Shinjuku Station that opens early and stays open until 5am, with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at some seats for late-night laptop work.

name: Gusto Shinjuku Yasukuni-dori
nameJa: ガスト 新宿靖国通店
description: A Gusto famiresu (family restaurant) on Yasukuni-dori near Kabukicho that runs from 6am to 5am, with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at some seats, good for working through the night.

name: Coffee Kizoku Edinburgh
description: A 24-hour kissaten (a traditional Japanese coffee house) a minute from Shinjuku-sanchome Station that serves siphon-brewed coffee and has free Wi-Fi and power outlets, so you can work at any hour.

name: Denny's Shinjuku Chuo Koen
nameJa: デニーズ 新宿中央公園店
address: 6-14-1 Nishi-Shinjuku, Shinjuku Green Tower Building 2F, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
description: A Denny's famiresu (family restaurant) near Shinjuku Central Park that is open until midnight with free Wi-Fi, though reports differ on how many power outlets it has.

name: McDonald's Higashi-Shinjuku Station
nameJa: マクドナルド 東新宿駅前店
description: A 24-hour McDonald's right by Higashi-Shinjuku Station with free Wi-Fi and about 87 seats over two floors, cheap for a late-night stop even though there are no power outlets.

name: Jonathan's Shibuya Shin-Minamiguchi
nameJa: ジョナサン 渋谷駅新南口店
address: 3-26-21 Shibuya, Tokyu Stay Shibuya Shin-Minamiguchi 1F, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
description: A Jonathan's famiresu (family restaurant) by Shibuya's new south exit that is open 6am to 5am with free Wi-Fi and a few power outlets, handy late at night although the Wi-Fi can be slow.

name: Gusto Shibuya Udagawacho
nameJa: ガスト 渋谷宇田川町店
description: A Gusto famiresu (family restaurant) in Udagawacho open 6am to 5am with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at some seats, one of the few spots near Shibuya open almost all night.

name: Hailey'5 Cafe Shibuya
address: 13-11 Udagawacho, KN Shibuya Building 7F, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
description: A 24-hour net cafe (an Internet and amusement cafe) near Shibuya Station with semi-private seating, free Wi-Fi and power outlets, charged by time and good for long work sessions.

name: Saizeriya Shibuya Tokyu Hands-mae
nameJa: サイゼリヤ 渋谷東急ハンズ前店
description: A cheap Saizeriya famiresu (family restaurant) near Tokyu Hands that stays open until 7am with free Wi-Fi but no power outlets, fine for a short late-night stop.

name: Bamiyan Jingumae
nameJa: バーミヤン 神宮前店
address: Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo (on Meiji-dori toward Harajuku)
description: A Bamiyan Chinese famiresu (family restaurant) on Meiji-dori that is open until 5am with free Wi-Fi and roomy seating, though you should not count on finding a power outlet.

name: Sakura Cafe Jimbocho
nameJa: サクラカフェ 神保町
description: A 24-hour cafe attached to a hostel near Jimbocho Station with free Wi-Fi, a cheap menu and a limited number of power outlets, relaxed for late work.

name: Denny's Higashi-Ginza
nameJa: デニーズ 東銀座店
description: A 24-hour Denny's famiresu (family restaurant) a few minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station with free Wi-Fi, though it is not on Denny's list of branches with power outlets.

name: Gusto Ikebukuro Nishiguchi
nameJa: ガスト 池袋西口店
description: A Gusto famiresu (family restaurant) by Ikebukuro's west exit open 6am to 5am with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at some seats for late-night work.

name: Tsubakiya Coffee Ikebukuro Charyo
nameJa: 椿屋珈琲 池袋茶寮
address: 1-6-4 Higashi-Ikebukuro, Ito Building B1F, Toshima-ku, Tokyo
description: A retro-style Tsubakiya coffee shop near Ikebukuro's east exit open until 5am with free Wi-Fi and power outlets, calm for late work but on the pricey side.

name: Saizeriya Ikebukuro 60-kaidori
nameJa: サイゼリヤ 池袋東口60階通り店
address: 1-14-1 Higashi-Ikebukuro, Ikebukuro Square B2F, Toshima-ku, Tokyo
description: A budget Saizeriya famiresu (family restaurant) near Ikebukuro's east exit open until 7am with free Wi-Fi but no power outlets, useful for a cheap late-night sit.

name: Gusto Mita Keio Daigakumae
nameJa: ガスト 三田慶応大学前店
address: 5-14-10 Shiba, Premier Stage Mita Keidaimae 2F, Minato-ku, Tokyo
description: A Gusto famiresu (family restaurant) near Mita and Tamachi stations that opens at 6am and runs until 11pm, with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at some seats for evening laptop work.
